ExifTool 13.62 by Phil Harvey (https://exiftool.org), bundled unmodified from
https://github.com/exiftool/exiftool so Studio Session's Metadata tab works without a separate install.

ExifTool is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the same terms as Perl
itself (the Perl Artistic License or the GNU General Public License). See README in this folder.

Studio Session runs it with macOS's built-in /usr/bin/perl. If an ExifTool is installed separately
(Homebrew or exiftool.org), the bundled copy is still preferred so results match what was tested.
